record.one_liner: Customer support and helpdesk platform (ticketing, users, organizations, help center) with a public REST API under /api/v2.
record.auth_notes: OAuth access tokens are the primary method. API tokens (deprecated) are used with Basic auth in the form {email_address}/token:{api_token}. Global OAuth tokens are required for apps distributed to multiple Zendesk customers.
record.access_notes: A free 14-day trial account gives API access. Sponsored developer-partner accounts are also available through Zendesk. Production distribution to other customers needs global OAuth.
record.api_notes: Paths such as /api/v2/users.json. Docs are organized by product capability (ticketing, help center, chat, voice, sales CRM).
record.blocker_notes: Self-serve trial credentials and a documented public API. No official Zendesk-hosted MCP server was found; only community servers. Global OAuth is required only when distributing to other customers.

evidence.quote: Zendesk supports using OAuth access tokens to authenticate API requests.
Basic authentication is used for API tokens.
You can try out the Zendesk platform with a free, 14-day trial account.
A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for interacting with the Zendesk API.
If you plan on making an app, integration, or bot available to multiple Zendesk customers, you must use global OAuth access tokens to authenticate Zendesk API requests.
